final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS health_safety_approval_status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS scans_in_set, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS group_average FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = si.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average FROM grouped) SELECT g.health_safety_approval_status, g.scans_in_set, g.group_average, g.group_average - o.overall_average AS average_minus_overall FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND g.group_average > o.overall_average
